data.acquisitionSummary: Current Orange Polska prepaid pricing explicitly offers account-validity extensions of +31 days for PLN9, +93 days for PLN19, and +365 days for PLN39. The old PLN5 inactivity-maintenance fee remains abolished since 24 January 2024. Current ordinary reload validity is also amount-dependent. The legacy PLN10/year model is therefore stale.

keep.action: Current Orange prepaid page explicitly offers +365 days of account validity for PLN39. Shorter extensions are +31d/PLN9 and +93d/PLN19. The former PLN5 inactivity fee was abolished in 2024.

data.chinaActivation: Polish prepaid numbers require registration. Orange supports several registration methods, but in-person registration accepts an identity card or passport; a reliable China-first new-number acquisition/activation path is not established.
data.kyc: Registration is mandatory. Orange explicitly accepts identity card or passport for in-person prepaid registration.
data.payment: Orange prepaid supports reloads and paid validity extensions; local online identity/payment rails may still make acquisition Poland-centered.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: Orange prepaid supports roaming; current packet does not establish China-specific incoming OTP reliability or whether all desired verification senders deliver consistently abroad.
data.refund: The former inactivity fee was withdrawn/refunded following regulatory intervention; no refund assumption is used for current prepaid validity extensions.
data.holdReason: Current annual validity economics are clear at PLN39/365 days, but new-number registration/acquisition remains Poland-centered and China/overseas OTP reliability is not independently verified.
data.tariffSummary: Current official account-validity extension: PLN39 for +365 days; old PLN5 inactivity fee abolished in 2024.
guideSteps: HOLD: PLN39/365-day validity is current first-party pricing.
Require stronger foreign acquisition and overseas OTP evidence before promotion.
